name: Yoke
overview: The biblical concept of the yoke symbolizes both burden and bondage, which God sovereignly breaks to bring His people into freedom and uprightness, as seen in Leviticus 26:13 and Jeremiah 28:2. Prophets like Isaiah and Jeremiah depict the yoke as a heavy oppression or sinful bondage that God removes through His power and anointing (Isaiah 9:4; 10:27; Jeremiah 2:20; 5:5). This theme highlights God's redemptive intervention to liberate His people from spiritual and physical oppression, calling them to live in obedience and dependence on Him rather than on worldly powers or sin.
